plugins.name: idle-stop
plugins.description: Stops a server when its last player leaves, and adds a live player list, kick, ban, ban list, a clear-bans/clear-session reset and on-join welcome messages. Supports Source/GoldSrc (A2S/RCON), Minecraft (RCON), Valheim (ValheimRcon), Palworld and Project Zomboid (Source-RCON). Includes admin and server tabs.
plugins.author: SpiritNetworks
